decisions.reason: The message directly refines substantive moment selection, but that effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Narrative completeness does not alter source-selection rules; the independently stated Arden Vale source collection is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
The complete-standalone-narrative standard does not change the required caption font.
The source defines ongoing clip content and deliverables but does not resume or modify the deferred task-local trial batch.
Narrative completeness does not itself alter duration; the explicit 70-85-second rule is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Selecting a complete standalone narrative does not change the clean and simple visual-editing standard.
The source decision does not change the white-text-only or no-text-effects requirements.
A complete lesson, story, or point can retain the existing good-hook criterion unchanged; no new hook rule is stated.
Narrative completeness does not change the output quota; the independently stated daily-output expectation is already represented by a same-message MODIFY.
The narrative-content refinement does not change which posted-clip metrics are tracked or the tracking transparency.
The complete-standalone-narrative standard does not alter the dedicated Instagram account's type, assignment, or purpose.
